info.name: I'll Show You How to Hunt

descriptions.notStarted: Let's get some information on hunting from #b#p1102005##k.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1102005# briefly explained the basics of hunting and asked that you hunt #r#o100120##ks, the weakest creatures in Ereve, as a test. He says you can attack by pressing the #bCtrl key#k, so let's try it out!
descriptions.completed: You have come back after hunting the #o0100120#s. #p1102005# says you can meet his brother #p1102006# if you continue to your left.
